description: Use this when the user wants to pause the timer to take a break. This temporarily stops time tracking while keeping the task active.

startDateTime.description: Optional pause start time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2025-10-08T12:00:00Z"). If not provided, uses current time.

name: timer_pause

duration.description: Duration of the running task in seconds

pause.description: The current break, while the timer is paused

task.description: The running task, with its project. Absent when no timer runs.

title: Pause Timer
